notes.title: Update 1.1 - Trophy Room!
notes.notes:
[h3]The latest update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition has arrived![/h3][h3][b]
🏆 Welcome to the Trophy Room! 🏆[/b][/h3][p]
This update is all about celebrating the moments that matter, the wins you’ve worked hard for, the milestones you’ve reached, and the goals still ahead of you.[/p][p] To mark these moments, we’ve added 25 new [b]in-game[/b] achievements throughout your Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition journey. Each one is designed to challenge your skills and give you something new to strive for. [/p][p]And where better to honour those in-game achievements than in your very own Trophy Room? Every time you complete an achievement, you’ll unlock a trophy to add to your collection. Pick it up, admire it up close, or display it proudly alongside your other hard-earned rewards, a keepsake of your journey.  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/e1ee011ecb990b618f3fbef13abbae702f9ca6ec.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Achievement List:[/b][/p][list][*][p]First Steps - get to prestige 2 on Flat Race[/p][/*][*][p]On the road to greatness - get to prestige 4 on Flat Race[/p][/*][*][p]World class - get to prestige 6 on Flat Race[/p][/*][*][p]First jumps - get to prestige 2 on Cross Country[/p][/*][*][p]Leaping for the stars - get to prestige 4 on Cross Country[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary champion - get to prestige 6 on Cross Country[/p][/*][*][p]Having a mare - breed 3 mares[/p][/*][*][p]Silver stallion - breed 3 stallions[/p][/*][*][p]Amateur breeder - breed 10 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Experienced breeder - breed 50 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Master breeder - breed 100 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Horse friends - own 3 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Four's a party - own 4 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Crowded house - own 7 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Full house - own 14 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Eat my dust - win a rival race 4 times[/p][/*][*][p]Big bucks - sell a horse worth more than 30,000[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer challenger - complete 1 online race[/p][/*][*][p]Championship racer - win 5 online races[/p][/*][*][p]First foal - own a horse with a grade of 2[/p][/*][*][p]Genetically superior - own a horse with a grade of 4[/p][/*][*][p]Bred to win - own a horse with a grade of 6[/p][/*][*][p]Horse whisperer - discover 15 of your horses' favourites[/p][/*][*][p]Unbreakable bond - reach bond level 5 with 1 horse[/p][/*][*][p]Horse tycoon - have 500,000 gold
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Further Changes and additions.[/b][/h3][p]
In response to your feedback, we’ve made a few changes to the controls and other early aspects of the game.  

An alternative horse racing control scheme using buttons and joysticks has been added alongside the existing motion controls, giving players who struggle with gestures a more responsive and intuitive option, which can be found in the pause menu during races. To support this, a new tutorial has been introduced to help players learn the updated controls.  

We have also adjusted the first horse preferences  to make the opening two races more exciting and enjoyable for players.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]  [/p][p]That's all for this update, folks. We hope you enjoy everything update 1.1 has to offer. To keep up to date with everything Rival Stars, make sure you join our Discord community. Until next time, Happy Riding!
[/p][p]
[b][i]1.1 Change List[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]New Environment: Trophy Room[/p][/*][*][p]New addition - In-game achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New Customisation Set[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now choose between motion controls and a new button-and-joystick control scheme for flat racing. This can be toggled via the pause menu during a race..[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now access a new tutorial to learn how to use the alternative control option.[/p][/*][*][p]We've made minor adjustments to the difficulty of the early races to make the game feel more rewarding right from the start[/p][/*][*][p]Applied a fix to reduce the number of game crashes experienced by players[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes and optimisations[/p][/*][/list]
